manifest.author: Sean Galliher and Cowork Cookbook contributors
manifest.description: Reviews your Outlook calendar for the week, summarizes meeting load and focus time, then proposes and — after your approval — applies accept/decline/reschedule and focus-block changes one at a time.
manifest.display_name: Rebalance your week and protect focus time
manifest.name: @cowork-cookbook/rebalance_your_week_and_protect_focus_time

details.license_note: Recipe content is CC BY 4.0 (share and adapt with attribution) and code is MIT. RAR carries each recipe's prompt, prerequisites, steps and expected output verbatim with attribution, so the toasted agent runs the real recipe; bundles and screenshots stay upstream.

conflict_priorities.description: How to prioritize when two meetings overlap.

context.description: Optional. Details the recipe should use — the record, scope, dates or filters it asks for.

manager_and_management_chain.description: Who your manager and management chain are, so meetings involving them can be flagged.

meetings_to_decline_or_shorten.description: Specific meetings you already want declined or shortened.

operation.description: What to do: run, prompt, plan, checklist, describe.

personal_commitments.description: Personal time blocks that must stay protected.

weekly_goals.description: What you are trying to accomplish this week, used to rank meeting importance.
